description: This app will be a big game-changer in integrating and leveraging ICT in disaster risk prevention, mitigation, response and recovery in the district, officials said | India News
body_lead: In a first, AI-powered app launched in Assam to combat floods This app will be a big game-changer in integrating and leveraging ICT in disaster risk prevention, mitigation, response and recovery in the district, officials said Silchar: Assam’s Cachar district administration has launched an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered application to combat flood situations by creating strong connectivity among people, security forces and government during the floods, officials said.
